question: In what numerical forms is this Lord described in the scriptures?
premises: The Lord is presented through multiple numerical configurations.
These configurations range from one to groups of seven and eight.
Each configuration names a distinct mode of manifestation.
inference: Thus the same Lord is described as appearing in progressively varied numerical forms.
uncertainties: The precise referents of saptaka and aṣṭaka are not explicit in this verse.
plain_english: He is described as the One Hero, then as the Paired One, as Three-Powered and Four-Natured, as Five-Formed, as Six-Natured, and as adorned with the sevenfold and eightfold.
